|lore=Ranat '''thief''' and scavenger from Aralia. Regularly trades with Jawas. Adept at pilfering items without alerting the owner. Willing to steal anything, even trash.
|game_text=During opponent’s turn, if present at a battleground site, may steal a device, droid, starfighter, vehicle, or weapon in opponent’s Lost Pile into your hand.

|notes=The Players Committee remaster for Reegesk gives official wording dated 4 December 2006. See [[Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|Original]] for the earlier presentation. Both texts let Reegesk steal one qualifying card while at a battleground site during the opponent’s turn. The later slip uses a singular theft subject to the [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 period One Rule].
